# Certificates for path-validation tests, from throwaway CAs built
# with OpenSSL. Lines are  name|hex  (DER).
#
# nc_ca is constrained to permitted DNS/email example.org and
# dirName O=Acme, excluded DNS bad.example.org. The nc_* leaves sit
# inside it, outside it, in the excluded subtree, and outside the
# permitted directory name -- OpenSSL accepts the first and rejects
# the other three, which is what the tests assert.
#
# pol_ca asserts policy 1.2.3.4.100; the pol_* leaves assert the
# same, a different one, anyPolicy, and none.
#
# nc_crl revokes nc_leaf_good. nc_aia names a CRL distribution
# point and an OCSP responder, and ocsp_request is the request
# OpenSSL builds for it -- byte-identical to ours, which is what
# checks the DER encoder and the SHA-1 CertID.
nc_ca|
nc_leaf_good|
nc_leaf_outside|
nc_leaf_excluded|
nc_leaf_baddn|
pol_ca|
pol_leaf_ok|
pol_leaf_other|
pol_leaf_any|
pol_leaf_none|
nc_aia|
nc_crl|
ocsp_request|305530533051304f304d300906052b0e03021a05000414be02d758b00bea3eda658e51c4916034d472bc1c04149abb7e555c25d16af6178928ce1e2681a61f6bf402141ceaefd7c7afd22a234887ca84853c4e4f40f665
#
# chain_* were built with OpenSSL 3.6 on 2026-10-02: chain_root (RSA,
# self-signed) issues chain_inter (CA, pathlen:0), which issues
# chain_leaf (no EKU); chain_leaf2 is issued BY chain_leaf, which is not
# a CA; chain_leaf512 is signed by chain_root with SHA-512; chain_ec256
# and chain_ec384 are self-signed ECDSA roots on P-256 and P-384, each
# issuing one leaf with the matching digest; chain_polext carries
# certificatePolicies, policyMappings, policyConstraints and
# inhibitAnyPolicy; chain_polempty carries a certificatePolicies
# extension whose one PolicyInformation is empty. chain_v1 is a v3
# certificate with its [0] version removed, so it parses as version 1
# and its signature no longer verifies.
chain_root|
chain_inter|
chain_leaf|
chain_leaf2|
chain_leaf512|
chain_ec256|
chain_ecleaf256|
chain_ec384|
chain_ecleaf384|
chain_polext|
chain_polempty|
chain_v1|
